## Which documentation needs improvement?
Provide links to the current documentation that needs to be improved.

## What is the problem with the current documentation?
Explain what is missing, unclear, or incorrect in the current documentation.

## What improvements would you like to see?
Describe how the documentation could be improved.

## Additional context
Add any other context or screenshots about the documentation improvement here.

## Would you be willing to contribute these changes?
Let us know if you'd be interested in updating the documentation yourself.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have checked that this is not already documented elsewhere
- [ ] I have checked that this is not already requested in another issue
- [ ] I have provided specific examples of what needs to be improved
